homily:
Takorlooriartigu Benjamin Vo. Takorlooriartigu aamma taanna widow-iusoq, taanna arnaq niviarsiaq, Jesusip oqaluttuassartaanik tusarnaartoq. 

Ullumi, inuunerup ilaanut, inuunerup nalaani takusinnaasatsinnut, iserfigissavarput. Arnaq taanna, widow-iusoq, taanna aningaasanik ikiliartortunik, marlunnik aningaasanik mikisunik, aningaasivimmut ikisivoq. Jesusip takuaa. Takuaa, sooq? Tassa, Jesusip takuaa, arnap taassuma uummataani suna nalaattarnersoq. Taanna arnaq, aningaasivimmut ikisivilluni, nammineerluni inuunerminik tunniussivoq. 

Benjamin, inuunermini, taassuma widow-iusup inuuneranik assingulluni, inuunermik tunniussilluni inuuvoq. Benjamin, inuunermini, inuunermik asannilluni, inuunermik qungujulalluni, aamma inuunermik kiffartuussilluni inuuvoq. Taassuma inuunera, ullumi, Guutip paarsisup asanninneranik takutitsivoq. Ben, inuunermini, inuunermik asannilluni, inuunermik qungujulalluni, aamma inuunermik kiffartuussilluni inuuvoq.

standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo aamma kikkut tamarmik toqusimasut, Naalagaap qaamanerani eqqissillutik sinissapput.
Kikkulluunniit aliasuttut, Guutip eqqissisillugillu neriunermik tunissavai.

readings.label: Atuagassiaq siulleq
readings.text: Uanga, Johannes, takuara savaaraq Sioni qaqqamiittoq, taassumalu peqatigai 144.000-it, taassuma atia aamma Ataatami atia niaquini allassimallugit. Nipi qilammit tusarpara, immap sarfarsuata nipiatut imaluunniit mommarluinnartutut. Nipi tusarakku tassaavoq qinngutartut qinngutartut nipiatut. Erinarsoqatigiittut nutaamik erinarsorput issiaviup saqqaani, uumasut sisamat aamma utoqqaat saqqaanni. Kinaluunniit erinarsuut taanna ilikkarsinnaanngilaa, 144.000-it kisimik nunamit pisiarineqarsimasut. Tassaapput savaaraq sumulluunniit ingerlaarpat malittartut. Inuit akornannit Guutimut aamma savaararmut siullertut pisiarineqarsimapput. Qungasequtaanni sallunaveeqqut nassaarineqanngilaq; kipineqanngillat.

readings.label: Tussiaat
readings.text: R. Naalagaq, tassa inuit illit saqqaat takorusuttut. Naalagaap nunarsuaq tamakkerlugu pigivaa; nunarsuaq aamma tassani najugallit tamarmik. Immap qaavanut tunngavilersimammagu aamma kuuit qaavini pilersissimammagu. R. Naalagaq, tassa inuit illit saqqaat takorusuttut. Kina Naalagaap qaqqaanut majuarfissaava? Imaluunniit kina illuani illernartumi nikissava? Kina assani illernartut, uummammi salitsut, kinaluunniit salloqittaanngitsumik kissaateqanngitsoq. R. Naalagaq, tassa inuit illit saqqaat takorusuttut. Naalagaamit pilluaqqussummik pissarsissaaq, Guutimullu annaassisiminut akissarsissaaq. Tassa inuit taassuminnga ujartuisut, Jakobip Guutiminut saqqaat ujartuisut. R. Naalagaq, tassa inuit illit saqqaat takorusuttut.

readings.label: Evangelium
readings.text: Jesus qiviarluni takuai inuit pisuut aningaasanik aningaasivimmut ikisissut, takuaalu arnaq widow-iusoq aningaasanik mikisunik marlunnik ikisisoq. Oqarpoq, 'Ilumut oqarfigissavassi, arnaq widow-iusoq taanna pisuunit tamanit amerlanerusunik ikisivoq; pisuut sinneruttunik ikisimmata, arnap taassuma pisuunnginnerminit inuunerminik tamanik tunniussivoq.'

day: Monday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
